sourceTitle: What Happens When a Country Goes Bankrupt
title: Argentina Has Defaulted Nine Times
question: How is it still borrowing?

scenes.narration: Argentina has defaulted on its debt nine times. And people still lend to it.
During its two thousand one collapse, Argentina ran through five presidents in under two weeks.
scenes.label: presidents in under 2 weeks

scenes.narration: Default after default, and yet the country is still issuing new bonds today. Because lenders chase the high interest, and bet it won't happen on their watch.
scenes.sub: high interest keeps the lenders coming

scenes.narration: How is it still borrowing at all?
